description: Current price and core market stats (market cap, 24h volume, 24h change) for one or more coins in one or more fiat/crypto currencies. Batch-friendly — pass a whole portfolio in one call (up to 250 ids). IDs must be CoinGecko slugs (bitcoin, ethereum), not tickers; resolve unknown tickers with coingecko_search_coins first. Any requested ids that returned no data are reported in the missing field (a wrong slug yields a silent upstream miss, not an error), so a typo reads as "unresolved", not "nonexistent".

ids.description: CoinGecko slugs to price (e.g. ["bitcoin","ethereum"]). Not tickers — resolve with coingecko_search_coins. Up to 250 per call.

vs_currencies.description: Currency codes to price against (e.g. ["usd","eur","btc"]). Defaults to ["usd"].

name: coingecko_get_prices

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `all_missing`: No requested ID returned data — every slug was unknown or the upstream response was empty. `rate_limited`: CoinGecko returned HTTP 429 — the shared keyless pool is throttled, or the Demo-tier quota was hit. `upstream_unreachable`: CoinGecko was unreachable or returned a 5xx/HTML error after all retry attempts. `invalid_response`: CoinGecko returned a body that could not be parsed as JSON. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

lastUpdatedAtUnixSec.description: Upstream last-updated time as a Unix timestamp in seconds (note: market-chart timestamps are milliseconds).

missing.description: Requested ids absent from the response (unknown slug or upstream silent miss). Re-resolve these with coingecko_search_coins. Empty when all ids resolved.

notice.description: Guidance when some requested ids returned no data — lists the missing ids and how to recover.

prices.description: One row per (id, currency) that returned a price. Data provided by CoinGecko.

items.description: Price and stats for one coin in one currency.

change24h.description: 24-hour price change as a percentage, when available.

currency.description: Currency code this row is denominated in.

marketCap.description: Market capitalization in the row currency, when available.

price.description: Current price in the row currency.

vol24h.description: 24-hour trading volume in the row currency, when available.

title: coingecko-mcp-server: get prices
